text: My main symptom is Presence of a left breast mass. I also have Rapid increase in size of the mass, No skin or nipple changes, No pain associated with the mass.

speaker: Doctor
text: The rapid growth over just four weeks in a painless mass is concerning, so I need to rule out inflammatory or aggressive conditions. Do you have any personal or family history of breast cancer, and have you experienced any fevers or night sweats recently? REQUEST TEST: Breast_Ultrasound
